newsitem.title: CHINA: U.S.'s Albright arrives in post-Deng Beijing.
newsitem.headline: U.S.'s Albright arrives in post-Deng Beijing.

text.p: U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright arrived in Beijing on Monday for talks with China's successors to the late Deng Xiaoping.
Albright, on the last stop of her nine-nation tour, stepped off her plane only hours after the body of the Chinese leader arrived at the Babaoshan cemetery for cremation.
She did not speak to reporters on arrival but Chinese and Western analysts have said Beijing was eager to present a face of stability and continuity to the outside world.
The U.S. official, making her first overseas trip since taking office last month, will meet President Jiang Zemin, Premier Li Peng and Foreign Minister Qian Qichen during her brief stay.
She met Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto over breakfast before boarding her flight to Beijing.
